title: Raaton-Raat Gayab Hua Pura Shehar 😱 | Dhanushkodi
description:
1964 ki ek raat… aur poora shehar samundar mein sama gaya. Ek train bhi kabhi wapas nahi aayi.
Aaj bhi shaam dhalte hi yahan koi nahi rukta. Kya aap rukoge?

#dhanushkodi #ghosttown #mystery #rameswaram

scenes.narration: सोचिए... एक पूरा शहर, जो सिर्फ़ एक रात में समंदर में समा गया।
scenes.visual_description: ruined coastal town on a sand strip at dusk
image_prompts: eerie ruins of a roofless coral-stone church and broken houses on a lonely sand strip at dusk, rusted railway tracks disappearing into the sand, nobody around
crumbling coral-stone wall with empty arched windows, waves crashing behind it, dusk

scenes.narration: ये है धनुषकोडी... भारत का आख़िरी छोर, जहाँ से श्रीलंका बस 30 किलोमीटर दूर है।
scenes.visual_description: narrow sand strip between two seas
image_prompts: aerial view of a long narrow sand spit with calm blue sea on one side and rough sea on the other, a thin road running to its tip
the road ending at the tip of the sand spit, sea on three sides, an island faintly on the horizon

scenes.narration: 1964 में यहाँ रौनक थी... स्कूल, चर्च, रेलवे स्टेशन, सब कुछ।
scenes.visual_description: busy 1960s railway station by the sea
image_prompts: a busy small Indian railway station in the 1960s, Tamil passengers in white dhotis and colourful saris, a black steam train, coconut palms
a lively Tamil fishing village with thatched huts and colourful wooden boats on the beach, coconut palms, a small whitewashed church

scenes.narration: फिर आई 22 दिसंबर की वो रात... और समंदर पागल हो गया।
scenes.visual_description: cyclone over the sea at night
image_prompts: a monstrous cyclone with black spiralling clouds and lightning over a small Tamil coastal village at night, coconut palms bending
coconut palm trees bent flat by hurricane winds, thatched roofs torn away, lightning, rain

scenes.narration: बीस फ़ीट ऊँची लहरें उठीं... और देखते ही देखते पूरा शहर डूब गया।
image_prompts: a gigantic wave towering over thatched huts and a small whitewashed church in a South Indian coastal village at night
flooded village lanes, thatched roofs barely above raging sea water, lightning in the sky

scenes.narration: उसी रात एक ट्रेन, सौ से ज़्यादा लोगों के साथ, लहरों में बह गई।
scenes.visual_description: old train hit by a wave at night
image_prompts: an old Indian steam passenger train with glowing windows on a coastal railway line at night, a massive wave crashing into it
train carriages tipping into the dark stormy sea, lightning, rain

scenes.narration: सुबह हुई, तो बस खंडहर बचे थे... सरकार ने कह दिया, अब यहाँ कोई नहीं रहेगा।
image_prompts: misty morning over a roofless ruined coral-stone church and twisted railway tracks half buried in sand, no people
broken walls of an abandoned railway station and an old water tank in fog, sand everywhere

scenes.narration: और कहते हैं... यहीं से भगवान राम ने लंका तक पुल बनाया था।
scenes.visual_description: stone bridge across the sea at dawn
image_prompts: a chain of sandbanks and rocks stretching across a calm sea toward a distant island at golden dawn, mythical glow
ancient stones floating on calm sea water, glowing softly in golden morning light

scenes.narration: आज भी शाम ढलते ही यहाँ कोई नहीं रुकता... क्या आप रुकेंगे?
scenes.visual_description: sunset over ruins and an empty beach
image_prompts: silhouette of a roofless ruined church against a blood-red sunset, empty beach, waves washing in
a lonely sand road at dusk leading to ruins, sea on both sides, nobody there

setting: Dhanushkodi, Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu, South India
